name: boxofficeblock
description: Bollywood & Indian Box Office Quantitative Trading Terminal inspired by order-block.com

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0].substring(1);let p=path.join(__dirname,f);if(!fs.existsSync(p)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}let ext=path.extname(p);let map={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':map[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);});server.listen(3000,()=>console.log('BoxOfficeBlock Terminal running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Antigravity Quantitative UI
